svg.text: Target rect TX, TY, TW, TH, TR (sheetRect)
the container animates from the card (origin) to this rect
inner content frame: TW × TH, never laid out again
useSafeAreaInsets() in your screens and the native-stack header
read 0, so phone screens need no change
topInset = 0: no −insets.top shift while the card is small
a Pressable fills the screen behind the card
tap outside → goBack() on the root navigator
→ usePreventRemove: the same collapse into the card
as the close button, Android back and Esc
drag down: travel from the finger to the card bottom (TY + TH)
edge swipe: from the card left edge to its right edge (TX + TW)
both still shrink the container linearly back to the card
(config.dismiss, on by default on iOS only)
sheetRect runs on every render from useSafeAreaFrame()
rotating or unfolding switches between card and full screen
while open; the inner Stack keeps its screens and state
enabled: false keeps the full screen everywhere
7 · The sheet: full screen or floating card
config.floatingSheet decides where the sheet ends up. Everything else (hand-off, close paths, inner Stack) stays the same.
Gray: backdrop (colors.backdrop at backdropOpacity), visible only around a card.
Sizes measured in the example app on web and on an Android emulator.
